messages:
sam: Config-only change scheduled — bump routing weight for model-rewrite-v2 in us-west from 0.08 -> 0.12 and increase request timeout to 18s. Deploybot scheduled at 2024-02-02T19:05:00Z. Canary plan: start 2% -> 20% over 10m, then ramp. Ops please ack for a 15m hold window after ramp. @deploy-bot

anita: Ack from infra. Kofi + Maya on-call will watch metrics. quick note: this is config-only, no model artifact swap. :thumbsup:

maria: Add rollback guard: automatic pin to model-rewrite-v1 on error thresholds (p95 or error rate). Rollback script located at runbooks/deploys/rollback-model-rewrite.sh

deploy-bot: Deploy started: job_id=deploy-1709456789. Canary phase: 2% traffic for 10m. Health checks: rps, p95 latency, error_rate. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/inflight/deploy-1709456789

reece: Watching dashboards now. Abort criteria I set: p95 > 1200ms OR error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 90s. Also added temporary tenant_qps_floor=5 to avoid noisy low-qps behavior. Will post logs if anything odd shows up.

anita: Small operational heads-up: KV-cache warmup may create transient tail-latency spikes on v2 instances — monitor kvcache-miss-rate and kvcache-fill time. I pushed a memory-pressure alert as well.

sam: Pasting the exact config snippet we're rolling (for record):
```
{
  "route": "model-rewrite-v2",
  "region": "us-west",
  "weights": {"v2": 0.12},
  "timeout_ms": 18000,
  "canary": {"start_pct": 2, "target_pct": 20, "duration_min": 10},
  "fallback": "model-rewrite-v1",
  "rollback_thresholds": {"p95_ms": 1200, "error_rate_pct": 0.5}
}
```

deploy-bot: Canary 5m in: health checks passing, error_rate=0.03%, p95=480ms. Increasing to 10% per plan.

maria: Observability check: no spikes in 503 or decoder OOMs. KV miss-rate trending down as caches warm — looks good. Ready for ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Beginning ramp to 100% over 15m window. Finalizing config application.

sam: Thanks team. Will update changelog: "Config-only: routing weight + timeout tweak for model-rewrite-v2 in us-west; automatic fallback to v1 on thresholds." Leaving thread open for 30m post-ramp for any late regressions. :coffee:
